scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary three-tupling of the boundary of the six-dimensional cyclic polytope is classified, for n>=7.
The theorem does not determine equivariant homotopy actions or higher-dimensional tuplings.
Unindexed equivalent previous work and later revisions are residual originality risks.
title: Parity and fundamental groups of cyclic six-polytope three-tuplings
